problem.passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Argentine ant (Linepithema humile) is native to South America but has spread to six continents through global trade.
- Unlike most ant species, which are aggressive toward colonies of the same species that are not their own, Argentine ants from different, geographically distant colonies rarely fight each other.
- Researchers attribute this lack of aggression to low genetic diversity among introduced populations, since most invasive colonies descend from a small number of original founders.
- Because they do not waste energy fighting one another, Argentine ant colonies can direct more resources toward reproduction and competing with native ant species.
- In California, this cooperative behavior has allowed a single "supercolony" of Argentine ants to stretch for hundreds of miles along the coast.
- Native ant populations in areas invaded by Argentine ants have declined sharply over the past several decades.

The student wants to explain why Argentine ants have been so successful at displacing native ant species. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
problem.stimulus:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
- The Argentine ant (Linepithema humile) is native to South America but has spread to six continents through global trade.
- Unlike most ant species, which are aggressive toward colonies of the same species that are not their own, Argentine ants from different, geographically distant colonies rarely fight each other.
- Researchers attribute this lack of aggression to low genetic diversity among introduced populations, since most invasive colonies descend from a small number of original founders.
- Because they do not waste energy fighting one another, Argentine ant colonies can direct more resources toward reproduction and competing with native ant species.
- In California, this cooperative behavior has allowed a single "supercolony" of Argentine ants to stretch for hundreds of miles along the coast.
- Native ant populations in areas invaded by Argentine ants have declined sharply over the past several decades.
problem.question: The student wants to explain why Argentine ants have been so successful at displacing native ant species. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
options: Because introduced Argentine ant populations have low genetic diversity, colonies from different areas do not fight each other and can instead put resources toward reproduction and outcompeting native ants.
Argentine ants are native to South America, but global trade has allowed them to spread to six continents over time.
Most ant species are aggressive toward colonies of their own species that are not genetically related to them, unlike Argentine ants.
In California, a single Argentine ant supercolony extends for hundreds of miles along the coastline.
problem.explanation: 학생의 목표는 아르헨티나개미가 토착 개미종을 성공적으로 대체한 '이유'를 설명하는 것이다. A는 낮은 유전적 다양성 때문에 서로 싸우지 않고, 그 결과 번식과 경쟁에 자원을 쓸 수 있다는 인과관계를 모두 연결해 성공의 원인을 정확히 설명한다. B는 단순히 분포 확산 사실만 언급해 성공 원인과 무관하다. C는 다른 개미종과의 차이만 말할 뿐 왜 성공했는지는 설명하지 않는다. D는 슈퍼군집이라는 결과의 한 사례만 제시할 뿐 그 원인은 설명하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The student's goal is to explain why Argentine ants have successfully displaced native ants. Choice A links the full causal chain from the notes: low genetic diversity leads to lack of fighting among colonies, which frees up resources for reproduction and competing with native ants. Choice B only states a fact about their spread, unrelated to the cause of their success. Choice C only notes a behavioral difference without explaining why it leads to success. Choice D mentions only one outcome (a supercolony) without explaining its cause.
problem.evidenceSpan: Researchers attribute this lack of aggression to low genetic diversity... Because they do not waste energy fighting one another, Argentine ant colonies can direct more resources toward reproduction and competing with native ant species.
problem.answerRationale: 정답은 낮은 유전적 다양성(원인) → 동료 군집과 싸우지 않음(결과1) → 번식·경쟁에 자원 집중(결과2) → 토착종 대체(최종 결과)라는 인과 사슬을 notes에서 그대로 연결해 '성공적으로 토착 개미를 밀어낸 이유'를 설명한다.

difficultyReasons: 여러 문장(유전적 다양성, 비공격성, 자원 배분, 경쟁 우위)을 종합해야 정답을 고를 수 있어 2단계 추론이 필요함
오답들이 모두 노트의 실제 문장과 부분적으로 일치하여 표면적으로는 그럴듯함
원인-결과 관계(낮은 유전적 다양성→비공격성→자원 절약→번식/경쟁력 강화)를 정확히 파악해야 함
선택지 B와 D는 지문과 무관하지 않지만 질문의 목적(성공 이유 설명)에 부합하지 않음을 구분해야 함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 지문에 실제로 등장하는 사실이라 관련성이 있어 보인다
distractors.matches: 노트의 첫 문장(원산지와 확산 정보)과 일치
distractors.whyWrong: 확산 경로만 설명할 뿐, 왜 토착 개미종을 몰아냈는지에 대한 원인 설명이 없다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 다른 개미종과의 비교라서 주제와 관련 있어 보이고, 성공 이유의 일부처럼 들린다
distractors.matches: 노트의 두 번째 문장(공격성 차이)과 일치
distractors.whyWrong: 왜 아르헨티나 개미가 서로 싸우지 않는지의 '원인'(낮은 유전적 다양성)과 그 결과(자원을 번식과 경쟁에 투입)를 모두 언급하지 않아 설명이 불완전하다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 슈퍼콜로니의 규모가 성공을 보여주는 것처럼 보인다
distractors.whyWrong: 슈퍼콜로니의 결과만 제시할 뿐 그 원인(낮은 유전적 다양성으로 인한 비공격성)을 설명하지 않아 '왜 성공했는가'에 대한 답이 되지 못한다
